# California Mortgage Concierge (californiamtg.com)

> Start with your situation, not a loan program. Build your mortgage scenario in a few simple steps, then route to an AI second-look review or a licensed mortgage professional. A California-focused service of West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc.

California Mortgage Concierge is a scenario-first mortgage service for California buyers, homeowners, and investors, led by broker Anatoliy Kanevsky in the Los Angeles area. It is built for complex and non-conventional files (self-employed, 1099, bank-statement, asset-depletion, DSCR, jumbo, non-warrantable condos) and for borrowers who were denied by a bank and want a second look.

- Market: California
- NMLS #2817729 · CA DRE Corporation License #02440065 · Broker Anatoliy Kanevsky NMLS #2775380 · CA DRE #01385024
- Contact: 310-654-1577 · Los Angeles area
- Equal Housing Opportunity. Rates and program availability change; nothing here is a commitment to lend.

## Start here
- [Home](https://californiamtg.com/): Build your scenario and choose a review path.
- [Loan options](https://californiamtg.com/loan-options): Overview of available programs.
- [Get pre-approved](https://californiamtg.com/get-preapproved): Begin the process.
- [Second look](https://californiamtg.com/second-look): A fresh review after a denial or a rate you want checked.

## Programs
- [Jumbo loans](https://californiamtg.com/jumbo-loans): Financing above conforming limits, including high-balance California markets.
- [High-balance conforming](https://californiamtg.com/high-balance-conforming): Conforming loans in high-cost counties.
- [DSCR loans](https://californiamtg.com/dscr-loans): Investor loans qualified on rental income.
- [Bank-statement loans](https://californiamtg.com/bank-statement-loans): Income from deposits for self-employed borrowers.
- [Self-employed mortgage](https://californiamtg.com/self-employed-mortgage): Qualifying options for business owners and 1099 earners.
- [Non-QM loans](https://californiamtg.com/non-qm-loans): Alternative-documentation financing.
- [Foreign-national loans](https://californiamtg.com/foreign-national-loans): Financing for non-US-resident buyers.
- [Cash-out refinance](https://californiamtg.com/cash-out-refinance): Pull equity for investment or consolidation.
- [Condo financing](https://californiamtg.com/condo-financing): Warrantable and non-warrantable condo loans.

## Tools and guides
- [Bank-statement income calculator](https://californiamtg.com/bank-statement-income-calculator): Estimate qualifying income from deposits.
- [DSCR calculator](https://californiamtg.com/dscr-calculator-california): Estimate a property's debt-service coverage.
- [Guides](https://californiamtg.com/guides/): In-depth California financing guides, including self-employed, 1099, asset-depletion, DSCR, and Pacific Palisades rebuild financing.
